corrections.summary: Move from device screen tree to semantic UNS structure
key_changes: Remove 'summary' grouping - distribute by measurement type
Move energy from measurement/ to kpi/ (accumulated values)
Move demand from measurement/ to kpi/ (windowed averages)
Move resets from maintenance/ to command/ (imperative actions)
Move setup from maintenance/ to config/ (parameters)
Change alarm display names to machine-readable IDs

measurement/summary/*.issue: Summary is a UI view, not a data category

measurement/kpi/*.issue: KPI nested under measurement violates semantics

measurement/power/*/demand/*.issue: Demand is windowed average for billing, not instantaneous

alarm/count/{Display Name}.issue: Spaces in paths, human labels not machine-readable
alarm/count/{Display Name}.fix: Use alarm/counts/{snake_case_id}, store labels in meta/

maintenance/reset/*.issue: Resets are commands, not maintenance category

maintenance/setup/*.issue: Setup parameters are configuration, not maintenance

Clock/*.issue: Clock is about device health, not top-level concern
Clock/*.fix: Move time to health/, offset to config/

naming_standards.phases: Use l1, l2, l3, neutral (not I1, V1, U12)
naming_standards.power_types: Use active, reactive, apparent (not p, q, s)
